flow_impact: Every flow that touches engine-plugin discovery, loading, or job-handler dynamic import (TTS Server boot, watchdog spawn args, mixed/xtts/voxtral job dispatch, plugin zip/GitHub install staging) now resolves against tts_engines/ instead of plugins/. No behavior change -- verified via full pytest suite, ruff, and a live app boot with GET /api/v1/tts/engines listing all three engines from the new path. HTTP-level /plugins/* routes on the TTS Server sub-app (refresh/import/preview/confirm/staging) and the WebSocket 'plugins.<id>.<area>' event-topic namespace are unaffected -- those are API/contract surfaces, not filesystem paths, and were explicitly kept unchanged per the brief.
notes: Ambiguity flagged for owner: the confirmed decision item 'rename mixed.py -> composite.py inside the tts_mixed engine bundle' has no literal target -- tts_engines/tts_mixed/ contains __init__.py, engine.py, handler.py, manifest.json, and tests/, with no file named mixed.py anywhere in the repo (verified with a full-repo find).
